segments.text: Neo-Seoul is falling. And somewhere beneath its rain, you wake up with no name. [pauses]
Every street has a price. Every signal has a history.
In Project MythOS, an AI Game Master carries your choices forward — into the next scene, the next road, and the people who choose to stand beside you.
Choose a path. Earn a companion's trust. Decide what you are willing to lose. [pauses]
When danger arrives, the story gives way to your command.
Read the enemy's next move. Take cover. Break their line.
Turn one decision into the moment that changes the fight. Because the outcome is yours.
And when the fight is over, Neo-Seoul remembers. [pauses]
Choose the story. Protect your people. Survive the loop.
Project MythOS. Closed Beta now recruiting.
